prompt:
You describe a block diagram or schematic from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What the diagram shows overall, in one sentence.
2. Every block or component, by its label.
3. Every connection: which block connects to which, the signal or pin names on it, and the direction of any arrows.
4. Every voltage, frequency, part value or other number shown, with its unit.

Figure type: block diagram or schematic
Section: 5. Functional description > 5.1 Power modes, boot procedure > 5.1.4 Forced mode
Caption: Figure 2: Power mode transitions
Text inside the figure (exact, from the PDF text layer): none
Text that mentions the figure: Power mode transitions are depicted in Figure 2.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Block diagram of Power mode transitions.

Blocks:
Power OFF (VDD and/or VDDIO=0)
OTP access granted
Suspend mode
Normal mode averaging as selected ODR
Forced mode averaging as selected
Magnetic reset

Connections:
Power OFF (VDD and/or VDDIO=0) connects to OTP access granted via an arrow.
OTP access granted connects to Suspend mode via an arrow.
OTP access granted connects to Suspend mode via an arrow labeled otp_cmd_reg=0x80 OTP access disabled.
Suspend mode connects to Normal mode averaging as selected ODR via an arrow labeled pmu_cmd=0x00.
Suspend mode connects to Forced mode averaging as selected via an arrow labeled pmu_cmd=0x01.
Suspend mode connects to Magnetic reset via an arrow.
Normal mode averaging as selected ODR connects to Suspend mode via an arrow labeled unconditional return to suspend.
Normal mode averaging as selected ODR connects to Forced mode averaging as selected via an arrow labeled pmu_cmd=0x03/0x04.
Forced mode averaging as selected connects to Suspend mode via an arrow labeled unconditional return to suspend.
Forced mode averaging as selected connects to Magnetic reset via an arrow labeled pmu_cmd=0x05..0x08.
Magnetic reset connects to Suspend mode via an arrow.

Numbers:
VDD and/or VDDIO=0
VDD>1.5V, VDDIO>1.5V
0x80
0x00
0x01
0x03/0x04
0x05..0x08
